One partition was left out: a partition holds a slice of its parent table's rows, and the parent is the model.
public.measurements is a partitioned table. It is emitted as an ordinary model; its partitioning is not something this target can describe.
public.audit_log has no primary key, so it is declared as a Table rather than a mapped class: SQLAlchemy's ORM needs a key to tell rows apart.
Index customers_lower_email_idx on public.customers is over an expression and was left out; it still exists in the database.
Index customers_active_idx on public.customers covers only some rows and was left out; it still exists in the database.
